verdict.rationale: BugSnag's docs show the triage states: the default inbox filter excludes errors that are "fixed, snoozed or ignored" (bugsnag-docs-28). Error actions are available from the dashboard and keyboard shortcuts (bugsnag-docs-42), and owner assignment can be automated with rules (bugsnag-docs-2, bugsnag-docs-41). Nothing in the pack shows a resolved error reopening automatically when it regresses, which is a core part of the story. missing for 10: documented automatic reopen of fixed errors on regression, detailed docs on manual assignment and snooze conditions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the triage workflow.
